verdict.rationale: The integrations docs say one command points a tool at a model and starts it with nothing to configure by hand. The `--cloud` docs describe it as an `opencode` flag that requests the hosted model instead of the one on this machine, which implies the default launch uses a local model, and the CLI runs local models offline without an account. Missing for 10: a documented list of the supported third-party coding agents (only opencode is named), detail on how each tool is configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the launch flow.
